attribution.text: NASA Earthdata (cite each collection by its DOI)

provenance.notes: CMR Search API docs (2026-11-10): rate throttling rules exist but no figure is published; over them, 429 with a retry-after header, which clients should honour. Request timeout 180 s. Client-Id header optional (helps operations). No User-Agent rule. Data use guidance: data from NASA-led missions are CC0 unless a collection carries a restriction or licence; non-NASA data follow the sponsoring organisation's licence; citation strongly urged (request, not requirement), NASA acknowledged as source; no implied endorsement. CMR search needs no account; file downloads from the DAACs need an Earthdata Login token. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
